What I'm focused on right now. Updated periodically; inspired by [nownownow.com](https://nownownow.com/){.external}.

## Working on

- Recently published *Sovereign Local AI*, a bilingual (French/English) book on running AI on your own hardware, with runnable companions: [read it](https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/localai-review/).
- ML tooling and R Shiny applications for fragrance & cosmetics R&D at Chanel Parfums Beauté.
- My public [Agentic Stats](/projects/agentic-stats.html) demo: an MCP server and FastAPI app that expose typed statistical tools to LLM agents, tested and containerised.
- Growing this site: case studies, reproducibility field notes, and the [Resources Catalog](/catalog/).
- Two CV variants generated from one profile source: a scientific software & AI track and a biostatistics track.
- Internal training material on Bayesian statistics with R.

## Learning

- Deeper MLOps on Azure ML and Databricks.
